brand-prompts.icon:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final flat square iOS app icon for Day by Word, a calm Bible reading companion. Create ONE icon, edge-to-edge square at 1024 x 1024, fully opaque, NO rounded outer corners.
Primary request: A simple sunrise above a single softly curved open-page horizon. Make one distinctive restrained geometric burnt-orange semicircle, sitting just above a low, broad, shallow pair of page-like curves that meet in a subtle central dip. The page/horizon forms are part of the same warm-orange silhouette, not a literal detailed book. It should read first as a new day and second as an open page. Large simple geometry, immediately legible at 60px and reducible to a single-color 16px mark.
Composition: center the motif in the square, all meaningful artwork within the central 65 percent; sun in upper-middle, paired low curves below, generous clean empty space. No rays, lines of writing, or small details.
Color: uniform warm off-white #FBFBFA background, motif predominantly #B9531A burnt orange with at most a very gentle #F4A26A warmth on the sun. Minimal flat matte graphic, crisp smooth vector-like edges. Quiet, modern, open Morning design.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, cross, church symbol, people, faces, Christ, saints, watermarks, embossing, drop shadow, dimensional app tile, picture frame, border, grid, icon mockup, photographic texture, gradients in background, or rounded-square frame. This is the actual final icon artwork, not a presentation board.

On the RIGHT, the referenced sunrise/open-page motif in burnt orange #B9531A, with generous breathing room and a subtle pale warm dawn atmosphere. Below in smaller regular sans-serif, two lines:

"Keep your place."
Typography must be crisp and professional, no additional text, no serif lettering, no tiny captions. Keep the two sentence lines comfortable and readable in thumbnail previews.
